data.name: SSO_Authority
data.value: SSO authority

data.name: SSO_Authority_Description
data.value: The OIDC authority URL for single sign-on authentication.

data.name: SSO_ClientId
data.value: SSO client ID

data.name: SSO_ClientId_Description
data.value: The OIDC client identifier for JIM.

data.name: SSO_Secret
data.value: SSO secret

data.name: SSO_Secret_Description
data.value: The OIDC client secret for JIM.

data.name: SSO_ApiScope
data.value: SSO API scope

data.name: SSO_ApiScope_Description
data.value: The OIDC API scope required for accessing JIM.

data.name: SSO_ClaimType
data.value: SSO claim type

data.name: SSO_ClaimType_Description
data.value: The claim type used to identify the user in SSO tokens.

data.name: SSO_MvAttribute
data.value: SSO Metaverse attribute

data.name: SSO_MvAttribute_Description
data.value: The Metaverse attribute used to match SSO claims to JIM users.

data.name: SSO_EnableLogOut
data.value: SSO enable log-out

data.name: SSO_EnableLogOut_Description
data.value: When enabled, users can log out of JIM and be redirected to the SSO provider's logout endpoint.

data.name: Sync_PartitionValidationMode
data.value: Run Profile partition validation

data.name: Sync_PartitionValidationMode_Description
data.value: Controls how JIM behaves when a Run Profile is executed for a Connected System that supports partitions but has none selected. 'Error' blocks execution; 'Warning' allows execution but logs a warning.

data.name: History_RetentionPeriod
data.value: History retention period

data.name: History_RetentionPeriod_Description
data.value: The duration for which activity and audit history is retained. Format: d.hh:mm:ss (e.g., '90.00:00:00' for 90 days).

data.name: History_ConfigurationChangeRetentionPeriod
data.value: Configuration change retention period

data.name: History_ConfigurationChangeRetentionPeriod_Description
data.value: The duration for which configuration change history (versioned Connected System, Synchronisation Rule, and Schedule snapshots) is retained. Kept separately from, and typically much longer than, the history retention period. Format: d.hh:mm:ss (e.g., '3650.00:00:00' for ~10 years).

data.name: History_CleanupBatchSize
data.value: History cleanup batch size

data.name: History_CleanupBatchSize_Description
data.value: Maximum number of records to delete per cleanup batch during housekeeping. Lower values reduce database load but take longer to clean up large volumes. Higher values are faster but may cause temporary performance impact.

data.name: History_SecurityEventRetentionPeriod
data.value: Security event retention period

data.name: History_SecurityEventRetentionPeriod_Description
data.value: The duration for which security audit event Activities (interactive sign-in success/failure, and failed API key or SSO access token authentication) are retained. Kept separately from the history and configuration change retention periods. Format: d.hh:mm:ss (e.g., '365.00:00:00' for ~1 year).

data.name: History_PasswordEventRetentionPeriod
data.value: Password Synchronisation retention period

data.name: History_PasswordEventRetentionPeriod_Description
data.value: The duration for which Password Synchronisation history is kept: the Activities recording what happened to each password change, and the queue rows that reached a terminal state (parked, expired, or cancelled). Changes still owed to a Connected System are never removed, however old. Shorten this to bound how long JIM holds an encrypted password it can no longer deliver. Format: d.hh:mm:ss (e.g., '365.00:00:00' for ~1 year).

data.name: ChangeTracking_CsoChanges_Enabled
data.value: Track CSO changes

data.name: ChangeTracking_CsoChanges_Enabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, change history is recorded for all Connected System Object create/update/delete operations. Disable to improve performance at the expense of audit trail.

data.name: ChangeTracking_MvoChanges_Enabled
data.value: Track MVO changes

data.name: ChangeTracking_MvoChanges_Enabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, change history is recorded for all Metaverse Object create/update/delete operations. Disable to improve performance at the expense of audit trail.

data.name: ChangeTracking_ConfigurationChanges_Enabled
data.value: Track configuration changes

data.name: ChangeTracking_ConfigurationChanges_Enabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, a redacted, versioned configuration snapshot is recorded on the Activity for every configuration create/update/delete (Synchronisation Rules, Connected Systems). Disable to stop capturing configuration change history.

data.name: ChangeTracking_SyncOutcomes_Level
data.value: Sync outcome tracking level

data.name: ChangeTracking_SyncOutcomes_Level_Description
data.value: Controls how much detail is recorded for sync outcome graphs on each Run Profile execution item. None: no outcome tracking (legacy behaviour). Standard: root-level outcomes (enables stat chips). Detailed: full causal chain with nested outcomes (default). Higher levels provide richer audit trails but increase storage usage.

data.name: Worker_StaleTaskTimeout
data.value: Stale task timeout

data.name: Worker_StaleTaskTimeout_Description
data.value: How long a running Worker task may go without a heartbeat before JIM treats its Worker as crashed: the Scheduler then fails the task's Activity and removes the task, so the work can be run again. Format: d.hh:mm:ss.

data.name: Sync_PageSize
data.value: Sync page size

data.name: Sync_PageSize_Description
data.value: The most Connected System Objects to process per database page during sync operations. A page also ends once its objects hold 100,000 attribute values, so very large groups never share a page. Larger values improve throughput by reducing database round trips. UI progress updates occur every 100 objects regardless of page size. Recommended range: 200-1000.

data.name: Sync_PostClearReconciliation_MaxMissingPercent
data.value: Post-clear reconciliation: maximum missing share

data.name: Sync_PostClearReconciliation_MaxMissingPercent_Description
data.value: The maximum share, as a percentage, of objects recorded at a Connector Space clear that may still be missing a re-join before the post-clear reconciliation sweep refuses to run. Above this, the sweep assumes the re-import was broken (a filter or base DN change) rather than a genuine mass departure, and refuses until you re-import the Connected System or raise this setting.

data.name: Preview_WorkerThreshold
data.value: Preview worker threshold

data.name: Preview_WorkerThreshold_Description
data.value: The estimated number of affected objects above which a configuration change preview is evaluated by JIM.Worker rather than in the portal's own process. Smaller previews run in-process so they return without waiting for the worker to pick them up. Both paths produce identical results.

data.name: Preview_FullDataSetPromptThreshold
data.value: Preview full data set prompt threshold

data.name: Preview_FullDataSetPromptThreshold_Description
data.value: The estimated number of object-level rows above which a configuration change preview asks whether to keep the full data set or only a sample of each summary group. Below this, previews keep a sample without asking. Summary counts are exact either way; the choice only affects how much can be drilled into, and how much storage the preview uses.

data.name: Security_EncryptionKeyPath
data.value: Encryption key storage path

data.name: Security_EncryptionKeyPath_Description
data.value: The file system path where encryption keys are stored. Set via JIM_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PATH environment variable. If not set, defaults to /data/keys (Docker) or the application data directory.

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_Enabled
data.value: API rate limiting enabled

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_Enabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, REST API requests are throttled per client (see the authenticated and unauthenticated request limits below). When disabled, no limiter is applied to any API request.

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_AuthenticatedRequestsPerMinute
data.value: Authenticated API requests per minute

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_AuthenticatedRequestsPerMinute_Description
data.value: The maximum number of REST API requests an authenticated client (a signed-in user or an API key) may make per rolling minute. Each authenticated principal is limited independently.

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_UnauthenticatedRequestsPerMinute
data.value: Unauthenticated API requests per minute

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_UnauthenticatedRequestsPerMinute_Description
data.value: The maximum number of REST API requests an unauthenticated client may make per one-minute window, identified by client IP address. Applies to anonymous endpoints and requests that failed API key authentication.

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_ScimServiceProviderRequestsPerMinute
data.value: SCIM Service Provider requests per minute

data.name: Security_RateLimiting_ScimServiceProviderRequestsPerMinute_Description
data.value: The maximum number of requests the SCIM clients of one Connected System may make to its SCIM 2.0 Service Provider endpoint per rolling minute. Shared by all of that Connected System's keys.

data.name: UI_ProgressUpdateInterval
data.value: Progress update interval

data.name: UI_ProgressUpdateInterval_Description
data.value: How often JIM reports progress while it generates Example Data from a template. Format: d.hh:mm:ss.

data.name: Instance_Name
data.value: Service Name

data.name: Instance_Name_Description
data.value: A friendly, editable name for this JIM instance. Appears in the sidebar, browser tab title, and footer so you can tell instances apart.

data.name: Instance_Id
data.value: Service ID

data.name: Instance_Id_Description
data.value: A stable, immutable identifier generated once when this JIM instance was created. Used by tooling, logs, and telemetry to identify this instance. Cannot be changed.

data.name: Security_ConfigurationChangeHashKey
data.value: Configuration change hash key

data.name: Security_ConfigurationChangeHashKey_Description
data.value: Server-held key used to detect changes to secret configuration values in change history without storing the values. Generated automatically; never displayed or edited.
